name: execute_batch
description: Apply 1..500 strictly-typed operations atomically (strict discriminatedUnion per action; sequential:true default preserves document order; single edit = 1-item batch). Caps 500 ops / 200MB throw E_QUOTA with remedy (maxSteps is an optional positive integer, unbounded when omitted). Client-supplied op ids are honored where the schema allows (insert/equation/footnote/chart accept `id`; strict schemas reject it elsewhere). Style ops support word-level spans: `match` styles only the matched substring (run splitting; `matchAll` styles every occurrence, `matchCase:false` matches case-insensitively); an absent match fails with E_NOT_FOUND. Returns {ok:true,appliedCount,revision,skippedIds,createdNodeIds,results:[{index,action,createdNodeIds}],revisionsPending,revisionsRemedy?} where createdNodeIds lists new node ids in document order (use them as anchors in the next batch without re-inspecting). A batch that drops a non-empty redo stack signals it (redoCleared:true + redoClearedWarning naming the depth): a fresh edit invalidates redo, so redo_document afterwards reports an empty stack. Example {"sessionId":"sess_abc","operations":[{"action":"replace","target":"p_001","text":"Hello"}],"sequential":true} -> {"ok":true,"appliedCount":1,"revision":2}. On failure returns {ok:false,code,remedy} with a fix-and-retry hint. Image inserts take exactly one source: {action:"image",operation:"insert",anchor,fileData} for inline base64 bytes, or {action:"image",operation:"insert",anchor,filePath} for a file read from a directory jail (both together fail with E_VALIDATION). The jail resolves explicit allowedDir first, else the session anchor (dirname of the open document); outside-jail refs fail with E_SANDBOX, missing files with E_IO, oversize files with E_LIMIT; batch reads nothing otherwise. Callout themes (operations/callout.ts THEMES): indigo|emerald|amber|slate|rose (default indigo; unknown names render indigo). Optional styleGuide (bundled guide name or guide .md path, jailed like filePath: explicit allowedDir else the session anchor; remote URLs fail closed) overrides the session guide for this batch only; it never replaces or persists (to re-skin the session use compose_document with styleGuide). Omitted inherits the session guide. Guides cannot be detached: an empty styleGuide fails with E_VALIDATION; open a new session to work without a guide. Unknown names fail with E_VALIDATION naming the available set. Guide parse notes ride both server stderr and the client-visible warnings array. Layout operations: {action:"section",operation:"setColumns",columns,spacing,separator} (columns 1-12, spacing in twips, separator draws the dividing rule), {action:"section",operation:"split"|"merge",...}, and {action:"pageSetup",orientation:"portrait"|"landscape",paperSize:"A4"|"Letter"|"Legal"|"A3",marginTop,marginBottom,marginLeft,marginRight,columns,sectionIndex} (margins in twips and written as given, never rotated; orientation turns the page by swapping its width and height; sectionIndex counts sections from 1 and limits the change to one section, omit it to change every section). Section breaks: {action:"insert",type:"sectionBreak",anchor,position,breakType:"nextPage"|"continuous"|"evenPage"|"oddPage"|"nextColumn"}; the section before the break keeps the page setup and headers of the section it splits. Headers and footers: {action:"headerFooter",operation:"set",targetType:"header"|"footer",text,alignment,sectionIndex (from 1, default the first section)}; {PAGE} and {NUMPAGES} inside text become live page-number fields. Images: width and height are integers in EMU (914400 per inch, 12700 per point, 9525 per pixel at 96 dpi); give one and the other follows the image aspect ratio, give neither and the image keeps its own size fitted to the page. Tables created by insert type:"table" or by Markdown repeat their header row across pages by default. Equations: {action:"equation",operation:"insert"|"replace",latex,mode:"auto"|"latex"|"plain"}; LaTeX that contains a backslash, ^ or _ becomes a real Word equation, and mode:"plain" keeps the text exactly as written. IDs are session-scoped: valid only in the issuing session, must not be stored across sessions, and duplicate client-supplied ids are rejected. ECMA-376 essentials: colors are hex without # (e.g. 4F46E5, never #4F46E5); font sizes are half-points in w:sz (e.g. 28 = 14pt, 22 = 11pt); spacing/margins/cellMar use twips dxa (twentieths of a point, e.g. 240 = 12pt, 180 = 9pt); borders use eighths-of-a-point sz (e.g. 32 = 4pt left accent). Workflow: open_document -> inspect_document -> search_content -> execute_batch -> save_document -> close_document. Always inspect first, batch second, save third. Single edit = 1-item batch. Never call twice when once suffices.
